svg.title: Control: checks and jumps
svg.desc: Five panels for the Lab 04 theory. 1: the countdown from ISA §9: eight bytes of code, JNZ jumps back to 0x0002 while Z = 0, and three iterations print 3, 2, 1. 2: if/else, while and do … while as blocks with conditional jumps forward and unconditional jumps back. 3: && and || skip the right side once the answer is known; 1 && 2 is true, 1 & 2 is 0. 4: a linear search for 0x41 in the data 10 20 41 30: H walks the cells, CMP finds a match at 0x0802, output 2; what happens without a match is a question for M4. 5: switch without break: INC falls through into DEC and A stays 5.
svg.text: if, while, for are comparisons and jumps. A loop is a jump back.
1. A loop is a jump back: counting 3, 2, 1 in ember
The program from ISA §9. Trace: ./run.sh 08 in the Lab 04 practice, 11 steps.
The JNZ operand 02 00 is 0x0002, low byte first.
Jump taken: PC = operand, the size is not added. Not taken: PC += 3.
The same in C++, with the check at the end:
Output 3 2 1. LOADI leaves the flags alone; DEC sets Z.
2. The forms are checks and jumps
for is a while with a counter. for (;;) is a JMP with no condition,
which is why run has a step limit.
3. && and || may skip the right side
read only if the left is true
left false → false at once, *p is never read
evaluated only if the left is false
left true → true at once, b is never evaluated
if (x = 0) is an assignment, not a comparison;
loop: LOAD A, [H] · CMP A, B · JZ found · INCH · JMP loop
H is i, INCH is ++i, CMP is ==, JZ is if. We look for B = 0x41.
And if 0x41 is not in the data?
H keeps going: 0x0804, 0x0805, … How to stop the loop at hi
and how to report a miss is your call in M4.
5. switch: without break, execution falls through
default: an unknown opcode (0x77) is an error, not silence.
